Oil is the most direct liquid proxy for Middle East war risk. llm_justification.summary: A sharp upward move in this market implies expected broad Middle East escalation, which most cleanly maps to higher oil risk premia (USO up) and modest pressure on Israeli equities (EIS down). But the market is a diffuse full-year count, poorly tied to a 12h window, so expected moves are small, confidence is low, and neither prediction is likely tradable unless accompanied by an actual breaking strike event.
